Pair 3: three vertical dominoes (count 3) and horizontal domino (count 1) → horizontal got 2. Good — this confirms shape (not size) matters, since all same size.

Pair 5: plus (5 cells, unique) got 2 while vertical dominoes (3×, 2 cells) got 1 → confirms rarest shape, not smallest.

Great. I have 6 solid demonstrations. Let me finish teaching.
All six demonstrations confirmed the rule: among the blue (8) objects, the one whose normalized shape occurs least often becomes color 2, and every other non-background cell becomes color 1.
